description: Start an order for a configured hosting or licence plan. Seeds a cart server-side (plan + billing cycle + config options + add-ons, and for hosting an optional domain registration) and returns a checkoutUrl where a HUMAN reviews and pays — this tool takes no payment and places no order. Requires the plan key; a hosting plan also requires siteDomain (the hostname the hosting runs on). A licence takes no siteDomain or domain and is always billed annually. Prices exclude VAT.

addonKey.description: The add-on's key, from the plan's addons.

quantity.description: How many units; 0 means not selected.

optionKey.description: The config option's key, from the plan's configOptions.

selectedValueKey.description: The chosen value's key, from that option's values.

siteDomain.description: The hostname the hosting runs on. Required for a hosting plan; not used for a licence.

name: begin_checkout
